set.body: Forward-review P1 against ADR 0001 D3/L4. contract.scala:152-170 calls BatchResult.conforms once and replaces every outcome with the same Invalid failure when one outcome has a wrong id/space. Executable three-item repro with only item 2 carrying the wrong space yields Invalid for items 1,2,3. Ordinary provider errors are isolated, but contract nonconformance poisons valid siblings and the current test at ContractSuite:105-117 endorses all-fail behavior. Acceptance: decide and document whether structural batch corruption must fail closed or whether index-local mismatches can be isolated; if L4 remains per-item, preserve provably matching siblings and fail only ambiguous/malformed positions, with mutation properties for one wrong space/id, missing, duplicate, and extra outcomes. Never silently reorder or misassociate a vector.
set.title: P1 embed result algebra: reconcile conforming wrapper with per-item isolation
